name: Vertex search
instructions:
### Relationships
- A lesson does not reference its course. Find it with `*[_type == "course" && references(^._id)][0]`.
- Modules are embedded objects in `course.modules[]` (not documents); each has `lessons[]` references. Module/lesson numbers come from array order and are not stored.
- `video` is an internal lookup, one per unique video. Join it to its lesson with `lesson.videoUrl == video.url`. Never return a video without the lesson that uses it.

### Matching
- Split the query into keywords, wildcard each (`"fetch*"`), and OR them. Never match a whole phrase as one pattern.
- `notes` is Portable Text: match `pt::text(notes)`, not `notes`.
- Inside an array filter, `match` with an array of patterns returns nothing. OR single patterns instead: `chapters[label match "cach*" || label match "fetch*"]`.

### Search recipe (run both, then merge)
1. Lessons on topic: match `title`, `pt::text(notes)` and `keyPoints[]`; rank with `score(boost(title match "kw*", 3), ...)` and `order(_score desc)`.
2. Video moments: match `chapters[].label` first. Only for videos with no chapter hit, fall back to `chunks[].text`. Project at most 3 matching chapters or chunks per video, never the whole `chunks` array. Every video has transcript chunks; only about half have chapters.
3. Rank by specificity: an exact concept in a lesson title or chapter label beats a broad notes hit. Return every relevant match, not a handful.
- Do not use `text::semanticSimilarity()`; embeddings are not enabled.
